claims: Artemis II is the first crewed mission to deep space in over 50 years.
Artemis II is a 10-day NASA mission.
The Artemis II crew will fly farther than any human before.
Artemis II is the first full-up test of NASA's deep-space navigation, propulsion, and life support systems while human crew are aboard.
Artemis II is the first time humans have traveled toward the Moon since 1972.
Artemis II serves as a direct precursor to landing the first woman and first person of color on the lunar surface.
Artemis II includes Jeremy Hansen, the first Canadian astronaut to travel beyond low Earth orbit.
The Artemis II crew includes Commander Reid Wiseman, Pilot Victor Glover, and Mission Specialists Christina Koch and Jeremy Hansen.
